title: Density of States
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct expression for the density of single-particle states D(ε).

title: Mean Occupation Number
description: Essential Criteria: Write down the correct expression for the mean occupation number n_ε as a function of ε, T, and μ.

title: Chemical Potential Integral
description: Important Criteria: Present the integral expression that determines μ(T) and explain its significance.

title: Bose-Einstein Transition
description: Important Criteria: Derive the expression for the Bose-Einstein transition temperature T_c and its dependence on density.

title: Chemical Potential Behavior
description: Important Criteria: Describe the behavior of μ(T) as temperature decreases below T_c.

title: Total Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: Find the correct expression for the total energy U(T, V) for T < T_c.

title: Sketch Accuracy
description: Optional Criteria: Accurately sketch the density of states and mean occupation number, indicating key features.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure all expressions maintain consistent units throughout the derivations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common sign mistakes, particularly in expressions involving μ.
